permissions.label: Read prompts
permissions.description: Sees each prompt and response of the agents it targets and may add bounded context.

permissions.label: Observe tool calls
permissions.description: Sees the tool calls and results of the agents it targets.

permissions.label: Block tool calls
permissions.description: May refuse a tool call before it runs.

permissions.label: Provide tools
permissions.description: Adds its own tools to the agents it targets.

permissions.label: Run in the background
permissions.description: Runs a periodic check while it is enabled, at most every 30 seconds.

permissions.label: Show notifications
permissions.description: Shows notifications in IRIS and on this device; important ones also reach your other devices while you are away.

permissions.label: Read public web sources
permissions.description: Reads the HTTPS addresses it declares, without credentials.

permissions.label: Read subscription state
permissions.description: Learns whether an OpenAI Codex subscription is active, without any account details.

permissions.label: Adjust automatic work estimate
permissions.description: May briefly raise or lower the remaining-quota estimate automatic work uses, within a small cap.

permissions.label: Connect to a remote service
permissions.description: IRIS connects to the remote MCP service it declares with your stored token and calls only the tools it lists.

permissions.label: Use your models
permissions.description: Asks one of your models for a text answer without tools; external content is passed only as data.
